cues: The e m f depends on the difference between the junctions.
If the reference junction is allowed to warm up to the same temperature as the hot one, the reading drops to zero, even though the furnace is white hot.
Always check the reference junction first.
text: A warning. The e m f depends on the difference between the junctions. If the reference junction is allowed to warm up to the same temperature as the hot one, the reading drops to zero, even though the furnace is white hot. Always check the reference junction first.
